question: Give me a blueprint of the Eiffel Tower

scenes.title: The Eiffel Tower, taken apart
scenes.subject: Eiffel Tower
scenes.caption: Four lattice legs that lean in until they meet at the second floor

parts.name: Legs and foundations
parts.role: Carries the whole tower down to the ground
parts.how: Each of the four legs stands on its own masonry piers set into the ground.
parts.made_of: Puddled iron lattice on stone and concrete piers

parts.name: Masonry piers
parts.role: Spread each leg's load into the soil

parts.name: Leg lattice
parts.role: Carries load and wind in a stiff, light frame
parts.how: Riveted iron bars form trusses, so most of the leg is open air.

parts.name: Middle section
parts.role: The legs lean in and merge
parts.how: The curve of the legs follows the wind load, so the tower needs no cross bracing.

parts.name: Second floor
parts.role: Where the legs become one column

parts.name: Upper column
parts.role: A single lattice shaft to the top floor

parts.name: Antennas
parts.role: Broadcast masts that take it to 330 m

unknowns: The exact width at each floor varies by source; the widths here are estimates
